Definition: from G4862 and G3870; to console jointly:--comfort together.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says he longs to see the Romans so that he may be comforted together with them by the mutual faith of both of them and him. Comfort is not one-way: the apostle needs the church's faith as much as the church needs his.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mutual faith comforts both ways, and I hold that I need the faith of my brothers and sisters as much as they need mine.
